name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) is too broad. The task says to turn off the siren each time it starts ringing, but `siren_ringing` remains true until switched off, so this clause is re-owed on every ringing step. Use Response from a proposition that marks the ring starting event, if one is declared; `siren_ringing` does not distinguish a new ring from an ongoing one.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) requires a switch toggle at or after each ringing step, matching the task.

texts: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
